error[ZBX-E0818]: a glob matched more paths than a build can hold
  cause  "src/**/*.go" matched more than 65536 paths in this build
  fix    match a directory instead of the files in it, narrow the glob, or .exclude what you do not need

  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0818.html
